P2: The identifier-type values SHALL be exactly the CDM
set — BIC, LEI, MIC, REDID, COUNTRY_CODE, OTHER — used verbatim (FCY standing rule R8).

The bean's search screen and edit form. The LegalEntity form reads as a standard two-section form: "Legal Entity" (name) and "Entity Identifiers" (the embedded identifier rows), each field label-above-field, helper text carrying the LEI format rule.

Each embedded EntityIdentifier row renders as a compact inline form in the pattern mature platforms use for child rows (Stripe-style metadata rows): identifier type and value side by side on one line (type narrower, value wider), proper labels above each field, no decorative emblem, no card chrome, and no per-row submit — the row saves with its parent LegalEntity. Save-time validation per R1 is the requirement; showing the LEI format as helper text while typing is presentational only.
cdm.base.staticdata.party.LegalEntity (vocabulary, from the cdm corpus) — the CDM type this bean realises; field set and requiredness taken from it.
cdm.base.staticdata.party.EntityIdentifier and cdm.base.staticdata.party.EntityIdentifierTypeEnum (vocabulary, from the cdm corpus) — the embedded child and its enum values.
ISO 17442 (vocabulary) — the LEI format (20 alphanumeric characters) behind R1.
FCY standing rules R7 and R8 (from the company corpus) — identifiers over free-text names; CDM enum values verbatim. This spec serves R7's identifier requirement at the legal-entity level.
Referencing CDM types (not changed by this spec):

Considered, none apply beyond the platform's own rules: authorization (any signed-in user, platform default), volume (reference data, tens of rows), availability, audit (platform trail), privacy, locale, cost.

A1 (verifies R1): WHEN a legal entity is saved with an identifier of type LEI whose value is not exactly 20 alphanumeric characters, THEN the system SHALL reject the save with a validation error naming the identifier field.
A2 (verifies R1): WHEN a legal entity is saved with an identifier of type LEI whose value is exactly 20 alphanumeric characters, THEN the system SHALL accept the save.

A3 (verifies P1): WHEN a legal entity is saved carrying two identifier rows with the same value — whether under the same type twice or under two different types (e.g. LEI and BIC) — THEN the system SHALL reject the save as a duplicate.
A4 (verifies P2): WHEN the identifier-type picker is rendered, THEN it SHALL offer exactly BIC, LEI, MIC, REDID, COUNTRY_CODE, OTHER and no other value.

A LegalEntity entity with its observer sheet, default listing and default form; an embedded EntityIdentifier bean edited inline on the LegalEntity form. (Derived block below.)
Implied by the bean blocks in the Data model and regenerated by the platform - do not edit this block; author above it what the catalog cannot derive.

LegalEntity - persistence.entity (persistence): The entity class with its builder, its descriptor + jsontype entry, its migration and table, and its tests; the descriptor is authored at spec time as the bean's entity-descriptor attachment (entity_descriptors/{qualified-descriptor-name}.json).
LegalEntity - observer.sheet (observer): The observer sheet: the entity's only remote surface, reads and writes.

LegalEntity - ui.defaultForm (ui): The default form of one row, rendered wherever the row is viewed or edited: its layout JS, authored at spec time as the spec's ui/{qualified-descriptor-name}.js attachment and shipped beside the entity class.

EntityIdentifier - embeddedBean (bean): A bean another bean embeds: its class with its builder, its descriptor + jsontype entry and its tests - a plain bean with NO persistence descriptor, so no migration, no table and no sheet; it lives inside the row of the bean that embeds it, and its descriptor is authored at spec time as its entity-descriptor attachment (entity_descriptors/{qualified-descriptor-name}.json).

EntityIdentifier - ui.defaultForm (ui): The default form of one row, rendered wherever the row is viewed or edited: its layout JS, authored at spec time as the spec's ui/{qualified-descriptor-name}.js attachment and shipped beside the entity class.
